verdict.rationale: Lithic's docs confirm a sandbox with dedicated endpoints to simulate merchant-acquirer transaction events end-to-end (cards, transactions, webhooks), directly supporting pre-production auth logic testing. However, the evidence never itemizes the specific lifecycle stages named in the story (clearings, reversals, refunds, declines) — only generic 'transaction events' and 'authorizations' are referenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of clearing/reversal/refund/decline simulation endpoints, and any hands-on/independent confirmation these work as described.
